description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the second-order periodic Laplacian rule central_D2_periodic driven by problems/heat_1d_periodic.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of N (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured solution exp(-alpha (2 pi)^2 t) cos(2 pi x) is the fundamental periodic mode; because the operator is the exact circulant 3-point Laplacian the single mode decays with the discrete eigenvalue's O(dx^2) error, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error and fall as O(h^2) with h = dx. Integrator tolerances are tightened to 1e-12/1e-14 so the tiny high-order errors stay spatial-dominated and cross-binding reproducible.
